source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar

items.name: Jump Jet
items.text: The firework pgo moves exclusively via Leaping. For each action spent to Drive, the pogo Leaps 20 feet horizontally or 10 feet vertically.

items.name: Unstable Launch
items.text: When the pilot uses a 3-action activity to recklessly Drive the firework pogo, it emits a burst of flames on launch that deals 3d6 fire damage to the pilot, the pogo itself, and each creature in a 10-foot radius (DC 19 basic Reflex save save).
